name: 22308 · Alexandria, VA
findings: ZIP 22308 (Alexandria) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22308 (Alexandria) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22308 (Alexandria) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
